Glossary

Norwegian terms are given in Nynorsk (nn), with Bokmål (nb) in brackets where it differs. Code uses the key in monospace (DOC-009).

HVL and Norwegian higher education

TermCode keyMeaning
HVL, Høgskulen på Vestlandet—Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. Campuses in Bergen, Førde, Haugesund, Sogndal and Stord.
ALU, Avdeling for utvikling av læring og undervisning—HVL's unit for the development of learning and teaching. Owns learning-design guidance and universal design guidance for teaching.
Faggruppa for digital læringsdesign—The digital learning design group in ALU.
TeCopp—HVL's cross-disciplinary team that manages Canvas, including LTI tool approval and testing.
Pedagogisk akademi—HVL's pedagogical academy. Merited teachers become members.
Merittert undervisar (nb: merittert underviser)—Merited teacher, a formal recognition of excellent teaching. HVL calls for applications every other year (next call 2027).
Opprykk—Academic promotion.
Pedagogisk mappemappeTeaching portfolio that documents practice and the reasoning behind it. Required for merit and promotion applications. For merit it has three parts: Del 1 samanhengande framstilling (nb: sammenhengende fremstilling), Del 2 pedagogisk CV, Del 3 attachments. In HVL Interaktiv the page /mappe (menu «Mappe», en "Portfolio") exports a draft of it from the author's own and co-authored activities, as Markdown to edit or as a tagged PDF (MAPPE-001…MAPPE-004, D-094); its template and criteria are in content/mappe/.
Emnedesign—Course design; also the name of HVL's course-design module for staff (UPED854).
Modellen for læringsdesign ved HVL, «HVL læringsdesign»—HVL's model for learning design. An alignment model built on three interdependent parts, kontekst, kunnskap and samskaping, applied across levels from the single læringsøkt (mikronivå) to the emne, studieprogram and institution, with baklengs planlegging (Møgelvang & Isaksen 2025).
Meningsskapande samsvar (nb: meningsskapende samsvar); samsvar i emnedesign—Constructive alignment: outcomes, activities and assessment fit together (Biggs). HVL describes it as samsvar mellom læringsutbyttebeskrivingar, vurdering, læringsaktivitetar … (UPED854).
Baklengs planlegging—Backward planning: start from the intended outcomes and design assessment and activities from them (Wiggins & McTighe).
Læringsøkt—A single learning session; the model's mikronivå, where HVL Interaktiv's activities sit.
Læringsutbytte, læringsutbyttebeskriving (nb: -beskrivelse)laeringsutbytteLearning outcome(s), as written in the course plan.
Kunnskap / ferdigheiter / generell kompetanse (nb: ferdigheter)kunnskap, ferdigheiter, generellKompetanseThe three outcome categories of the Norwegian Qualifications Framework (NKR).
ForarbeidforarbeidAsynchronous pre-work before a session (en label "Pre-work"). The first of the studio's three phases; pattern IDs fa-…. Every phase label is read from content/laeringsdesign/phases.yaml, so ALU renames a phase without code (PED-001); code and the database know only the key.
Samling / nettsamlingsamlingThe synchronous session: seminar, lecture, lab or online meeting (nettsamling); en "Session". The anchor the three phases sit around (anchor in phases.yaml), shown as its own column in the phase matrix on /laeringsdesign; never authored.
MellomarbeidunderveisAsynchronous work between sessions or during placement (en label "Intermediate work"); pattern IDs uv-…. The code key keeps its earlier name (D-019).
EtterarbeidetterarbeidAsynchronous consolidation after a session (en label "Post-work"); pattern IDs ea-…. The planner marks a learning outcome with no Etterarbeid activity as a gap (D-088).
Eigenvurdering (nb: egenvurdering)—Self-assessment.
Undervegsvurdering (nb: underveisvurdering)—Formative assessment. Not a phase; do not confuse with mellomarbeid.
Sluttvurdering—Summative assessment (exam). Out of scope.
Praksis—Work placement (clinical, school, etc.).
Profesjonell dømmekraft—Professional judgement.
Didaktisk skjønn—Didactic discretion: a teacher's situated judgement about teaching.
PPU—Praktisk-pedagogisk utdanning, a one-year teacher-education programme.
GLU—Grunnskulelærarutdanning, primary and lower-secondary teacher education.
Universell utforming (UU)—Universal design. For ICT it is regulated by law.
UUtilsynet—The Norwegian authority that supervises universal design of ICT.
uustatus.no—The national portal where public bodies publish accessibility statements.
Tilgjengelegheitserklæring (nb: tilgjengelighetserklæring)—Accessibility statement.
Feide—The national login federation for Norwegian education, operated by Sikt.
ROS-analyse, risiko- og sårbarheitsanalyse (nb: sårbarhetsanalyse)—Risk and vulnerability analysis: the risks of a system scored by likelihood and consequence, with measures and an owner for each. HVL IT does its own in HVL's template; assurance/ros-analyse.md ↗ (opens external site) is a draft for IT to correct, with ROS-nn IDs (D-116).
Nynorsk (nn) / Bokmål (nb)nn, nbThe two written standards of Norwegian. HVL uses Nynorsk as its main administrative language.

UI words used in HVL Interaktiv

UI text (nn)Meaning
InnsiktInsight (teacher analytics): the Innsikt tab on the activity page and on an author's Canvas page, one activity, version, context and fixed period at a time (S6, D-101, D-106)
Før samlinga (nb: før samlingen)"Before the session" (the default insight view); the tab's heading is «Innsikt før samlinga»
Ta opp i samlinga (nb: Ta opp i samlingen)"Bring to the session" (shortlist button); the list can be printed or shown «på storskjerm» (projected)
Deltaking / Starta / Fullført / Fullføringsgrad (nb: Deltakelse / Startet / Fullført / Fullføringsgrad)Participation / Started / Completed / Completion rate on the Innsikt tab (INS-001); started is any stored statement, completed a stored final result (D-115)
Tal til og med i går (nb: Tall til og med i går)"Figures up to and including yesterday": the period note on the Innsikt tab. Every view ends at the latest midnight in Oslo, so what learners do today shows tomorrow; from 2 to 30 August a view starts on 1 August and the note says it is shortened (D-106's amendment of 2026-11-04)
Misoppfatningar (nb: Misoppfatninger)Misconceptions: the first answers to choice and gap questions, with the teacher's own feedback by each wrong option (INS-003)
Spørsmål, vanskelegast først (nb: Spørsmål, vanskeligst først)"Questions, hardest first": the Innsikt tab's table of each question's share «Riktig på første forsøk» and «Riktig på siste forsøk» (correct on the first and on the latest attempt), the hardest first (INS-002)
Luke (nb: same)"Gap": a blank to fill in a Blanks or DragText task. On the Innsikt tab each gap lists the right answers, the wrong answers at least k learners gave, «Andre feil svar» (other wrong answers) and «Tom luke» (left empty), from the learners' first answers (INS-003, D-106's amendment of 2026-11-04)
Emne / Portalen (spelt utanom Canvas) (nb: Emne / Portalen (spilt utenom Canvas))"Course" / "The portal (played outside Canvas)": the Innsikt tab's context, one at a time: a Canvas course, named by its course code, or the plays in the portal. In Canvas the launch fixes the course (INS-007, D-103, D-106)
Siste 7 dagar / Sidan semesterstart (nb: Siste 7 dager / Siden semesterstart)"Last 7 days" / "Since the semester started": the Innsikt tab's fixed periods (also 14 and 30 days). There are no dates of one's own, because two chosen periods together could single out one learner (SPEC-DEVIATION: D-106)
Tilgjengelegheit og kvalitet (nb: Tilgjengelighet og kvalitet)"Accessibility and quality": the Innsikt tab's section with the pre-publish check's findings and the reasons that hold, so accessibility debt stays in view (INS-010)
Minste gruppe (k) (nb: same)"Smallest group (k)": the line in the insight CSV that gives k, the minimum group size below which a value is hidden («< k») (INS-006, INS-009)
Skjult av omsyn til personvernet (nb: skjult av hensyn til personvernet)"Hidden for privacy": what a screen reader hears after «< 5», a value about fewer than k learners or one hidden so that another cannot be worked out (INS-006, D-106)
Poeng til Canvas"Scores to Canvas": the tab with the counts of formative scores per course: «Sendt til Canvas», «Ventar på å bli sendt» (nb: «Venter på å bli sendt»), «Feila» (nb: «Feilet») and «Oppgåva er sletta i Canvas» (nb: «Oppgaven er slettet i Canvas», the assignment is gone), and the button «Send feila poeng på nytt» (nb: «Send feilede poeng på nytt») (LTI-012, D-104)
Karakterbok (nb: same)The Canvas gradebook (karakterboka), which gets the formative scores of an activity placed as an assignment. The Deep Linking picker says «Ingen poeng til karakterboka» (nb: «Ingen poeng til karakterboken») beside an activity whose type, as it is set up, sends no score, so its column stays empty (LTI-012, D-115)
Poengregel (nb: same)"Score rule": which attempt's score goes to Canvas: the best, the latest, or 100 once an attempt reaches the mastery threshold (80 % by default) (LtiPlacement.attemptPolicy, LTI-012, D-104, D-115)
(formativ)The suffix on a graded activity's assignment name in Canvas, «Tittel (formativ)», the same in every language, so the scores read as formative (LTI-013, AGS_LABEL_MODE=suffix, D-105; whether HVL allows it is Q8)
RedigerEdit
Riktig / FeilCorrect / Incorrect (feedback prefixes)
HjelpHelp
PersonvernPrivacy (the footer link to the privacy page, DATA-006)
Utkast / PublisertDraft / Published: an activity's two states. Learners and Deep Linking see published activities only (PROD-003, PROD-004)
Publiser / Gjer om til utkast (nb: Gjør om til utkast)Publish / Turn back into a draft (unpublish)
SjekkThe pre-publish check: the validator's findings for one activity (UD-020)
Sjekk / Vis svar / Prøv igjen / Send inn (H5P's buttons)Check / Show solution / Retry / Submit: the buttons of H5P's question types, in Nynorsk and Bokmål through HVL's language overlay (H5P-008, D-111). H5P's «Sjekk» checks a learner's answers; it is not the activity page's Sjekk og publiser
Viruskontroll (nb: same)"Virus check": with ClamAV configured (required in production unless HVL turns it off explicitly), every uploaded file is scanned before it is stored, and the editor says when the check found harmful content, or could not check the file, and that it was not saved (SEC-006, D-110)
Grunngjeving (nb: begrunnelse)The author's reason for publishing despite an error; stored as a ValidationAcknowledgement and valid for 14 days (UD-022, D-074)
Grunngje på nytt (nb: Begrunn på nytt)"Explain again": new reasons for a published activity with an error that has no reason that holds; the same publish request, and the activity stays published (D-074 amendment)
Gå til feltet"Go to the field": the link from a finding to the field in the editor (UD-021)
Eigar / Medforfattar (nb: Eier / Medforfatter)Owner / Co-author of an activity. A co-author may edit, publish and share it (ContentCollaborator, role coauthor). On the Deling tab the owner adds co-authors by name or Feide ID from HVL staff authors only, at most 20, and a co-author may remove themselves (PROD-007, D-090)
Læringsdesign / DelingThe activity page's Learning design and Sharing tabs (S5, D-089): see the studio section below; Deling holds visibility, co-authors, the content bank listing and «Lag ein kopi»
Lagre som ny versjon"Save as new version": in the editor's save choice, when a structural change would reset other people's saved progress, the change is saved as a private copy and the original and its learner state stay untouched (portal only; PROD-013, D-093). The other choices are «Nullstill framgangen og lagre» (nb: «Nullstill fremgangen og lagre») and «Avbryt»

The læringsdesign studio and the pedagogisk mappe (Session 5)

The studio's own words, as the pages show them in Nynorsk, with Bokmål where it differs and the English UI text in the meaning. Spec 04 and D-082…D-100 hold the rules; ALU edits the texts behind them in content/.

TermCode keyMeaning
Læringsdesign-rettleiinga (nb: -veiledningen)guide.{nn,nb,en}.mdThe guide on the public page /laeringsdesign (menu «Læringsdesign», en "Learning design"): why asynchronous work often fails, «HVL læringsdesign» in brief, three mechanisms each with a box «Kva dette betyr for aktiviteten din» (nb: «Hva dette betyr for aktiviteten din», en "What this means for your activity"), the phase matrix and the pattern catalogue, and where to get help (PED-002). ALU's Markdown, shown through a closed node tree (D-083).
Mønster (nb: plural mønstre)patternId; content/laeringsdesign/patterns/<id>/Pattern: a tried way of building one kind of activity: what it is for, when to use it, an example, why it works (with research references), build and student minutes, and a skeleton the new activity starts from (spec 04 §4, PED-010, D-084). ALU adds a pattern as a folder, with no code (PED-011). Each pattern has its page /laeringsdesign/monster/<id> with «Lag frå dette mønsteret» (nb: «Lag fra dette mønsteret», en "Create from this pattern"), which creates a private draft in one request (PROD-001, D-085).
Mønsterkatalog (nb: same)#monsterkatalog; ?fase=&type=&tid=&emne=Pattern catalogue: the patterns on /laeringsdesign, headed «Mønsterkatalogen», filtered by phase, content type and longest build time. The filters live in the address, so a shared link restores them (PED-003); the guide places the catalogue with its {{pattern-catalogue}} marker.
Plassheldar (nb: plassholder)⟦…⟧; V-PLACEHOLDERPlaceholder: guidance a pattern's skeleton puts where the author's own content goes, wrapped in ⟦ and ⟧ (U+27E6, U+27E7). The pages call it «rettleiing frå mønsteret» (nb: «veiledning fra mønsteret», en "guidance from the pattern"). The validator rule V-PLACEHOLDER reports every field that still holds one, and an empty video or background image, as an error that can be published past only with a reason (D-086, D-074).
Læringsdesign-fana (nb: Læringsdesign-fanen)?fane=learning-designLearning design tab («Læringsdesign», en "Learning design") on an activity's page /aktivitet/<id>, for the people who may edit it: phase, course code (emnekode), learning outcomes with their NKR category, the didactic rationale (grunngjeving), the student minutes and the one-line purpose students see before they start (PED-030, PED-032, D-087). The publish dialog asks for it but never blocks.
Planleggar (nb: planlegger)/laeringsdesign/planlegg; plannerAlignment planner (UI en "Planner"): for one course code, a table of the author's learning outcomes × the three phases, built from their own and co-authored activities. It marks two gaps with an icon and a text: an outcome with no Etterarbeid activity, and a phase with no activity. An empty cell offers «Lag frå mønster» (PED-031, D-088). Authors only.
Innhaldsbank (nb: innholdsbank)/laeringsdesign/innhaldsbank; H5PContent.bankListedAtContent bank: published activities, shared with HVL or wider, that their owners have listed so that colleagues can copy and adapt them (PROD-007, D-091). Listing needs the owner's consent to a text that is a draft for ALU and HVL's lawyers (Q17); unpublishing the activity or making it private takes it out. Only HVL staff authors see it, list in it and copy from it, because it shows colleagues' names.
Kopi / kjelde (nb: kopi / kilde)sourceContentId, sourceAuthorUserIdCopy / source: «Lag ein kopi» (nb: «Lag en kopi», en "Make a copy", on the Deling tab and in the content bank) and «Lagre som ny versjon» make a private draft that remembers the activity it came from and that activity's author. The copy's page shows «Kopi av «tittel» av namn» (en: Copy of “title” by name) to the people who may edit it: the source attribution (D-092). Learner data, co-authors, placements and the bank listing are never copied.
Lesarrettleiing (nb: leserveiledning){{lesarrettleiing}}Reader's guide at the start of the pedagogisk mappe: a table of every criterion of the chosen criteria set, where in the portfolio it is answered and which attachment documents it. The server builds it from the criteria file, not from the template, and its words do not count in Del 1 (MAPPE-002, D-094).
Del 1 (en: Part 1){{del1_start}} … {{del1_slutt}}The first part of a merit portfolio, samanhengande framstilling (nb: sammenhengende fremstilling, en "continuous text"); Del 2 is the pedagogisk CV (teaching CV) and Del 3 the attachments (vedlegg). The export counts the words between the two markers only, without the reader's guide and the references, against the set's limit (7 500 in HVL's 2025 call, (verify); D-094).
Kriteriesett (nb: same)criteria.{nn,nb,en}.yaml; hvl-merittering-2025Criteria set: the merit criteria of one HVL call (1.1–3.3 in 2025), with that call's limits for Del 1 words and attachments. The author chooses the set on /mappe; another set changes every criterion text, the reader's guide and the limits, with no code change (MAPPE-002).

Technical terms

TermMeaning
H5POpen-source framework for interactive HTML5 learning content. Content is a JSON parameter object (content.json) rendered by a content type library.
Content type / libraryA versioned H5P package such as H5P.MultiChoice 1.16. Runnable libraries can be authored directly; others are dependencies.
Core API versionThe H5P core contract version (here 1.28). Libraries declare the core version they need.
H5P HubH5P's registry of content types (hub-api.h5p.org from 2026).
Lumi h5p-server@lumieducation/h5p-server, a Node.js re-implementation of H5P's server side.
xAPI statementAn "actor – verb – object – result" record emitted by H5P when a learner interacts.
LTI 1.3 / LTI Advantage1EdTech standard for launching tools from an LMS. Advantage adds Deep Linking, Assignment and Grade Services, and Names and Role Provisioning.
Platform / ToolIn LTI, Canvas is the platform and HVL Interaktiv is the tool.
Deployment (LTI)One installation of a developer key in a Canvas account or course, named by the deployment_id claim; a platform can have several. Only deployments listed in LTI_PLATFORMS (stored as LtiDeployment rows) may launch the tool. ltijs does not check this itself (D-051).
Placement (Canvas)Where Canvas offers a tool, set per developer key. Ours: assignment_selection (an assignment's external tool; the only one that creates a gradebook column), link_selection (a module item) and editor_button (the rich content editor). The custom field hvl_placement repeats the placement's name, for launches where Canvas's own placement claim is missing (D-061). Not the same as an LtiPlacement row, which records one activity placed in one course through one resource link (LTI-006).
Deep Linking 2.0LTI flow where a teacher picks content in the tool, which is then placed in Canvas. Canvas opens the tool from a placement with an LtiDeepLinkingRequest launch; the tool shows its picker (/lti/deeplink, server-rendered, D-067) and returns the chosen activities as a signed LtiDeepLinkingResponse JWT to the platform's deep_link_return_url (LTI-005, D-061).
AGSAssignment and Grade Services: the tool sends scores to the Canvas gradebook.
NRPSNames and Role Provisioning Services: the tool can read course membership. We read counts only.
ltikltijs launch token: an RS256-signed JWT that holds only the ID of the stored launch record (tid) and is valid for 24 hours. It replaces cookies inside the Canvas iframe. It travels as Authorization: Bearer; only /app/play, /lti/play, /lti/edit, /lti/deeplink, /h5p/ajax and /h5p/contentUserData/… accept it in the query (D-058, D-069). It lives in page memory only, never in browser storage or logs, and the landing script removes it from the address bar (LTI-003).
Recovery token (ltijs)A value ltijs 7 makes at the OIDC login step: an HMAC-signed state ID that expires after 10 minutes. The browser keeps it in the tool frame's localStorage or, where that storage is blocked, in LTI Platform Storage, and posts it back with the launch, so ltijs can match the launch to its login without a cookie. It grants nothing on its own; the ltik is never stored this way (D-050).
LTI Platform StorageThe 1EdTech LTI client-side postMessage API: the tool frame asks a sibling frame of the platform, named by lti_storage_target at login initiation (Canvas serves it from sso.canvaslms.com), to keep a value for it (lti.put_data, lti.get_data). ltijs uses it for its recovery token when the browser blocks storage in third-party frames; with storage blocked and no lti_storage_target, the launch fails (D-050).
Developer KeyCanvas's registration record for an LTI tool: its URLs, scopes, placements, privacy level and custom fields. Ours is docs/reference/canvas-lti13-developer-key.json; the client ID Canvas gives it goes into LTI_PLATFORMS.
feide_loginA custom field in our developer key, $Canvas.user.loginId, set on the Deep Linking placements only. The server reads it only for authors and only from platforms with "feideLinking": true in LTI_PLATFORMS, ignores an unexpanded $… value, uses it to join the teacher's Canvas identity to the account of an earlier Feide login, and never stores it (AUTH-005, D-052, D-063).
OIDC / PKCEOpenID Connect login, and Proof Key for Code Exchange, which protects the authorisation-code flow.
Feide IDA person's Feide identifier (eduPersonPrincipalName, e.g. name@hvl.no) in the claim https://n.feide.no/claims/eduPersonPrincipalName (scope userid-feide). It is the Feide subject in HVL Interaktiv: trimmed and lower-cased, then only hashed (Identity.subjectHash, the learnerKey) or compared (ADMIN_FEIDE_IDS, feide_login), never stored (D-054).
Groups API (Feide)Feide's API for a user's groups: GET https://groups-api.dataporten.no/groups/me/groups with the user's access token. The organisation group fc:org:<realm> carries membership.affiliation (e.g. employee, student); FS course groups look like fc:fs:fs:emne:<realm>:<code>:<version>. Roles are computed from it at login; if the call fails, the login fails (AUTH-002, D-054).
Login transactionOne Feide login in progress: its state, nonce, PKCE verifier and checked return path, kept in Redis for at most 10 minutes and bound to the browser by the __Host-hvli_login cookie. The callback consumes it once, so a callback replayed or forced on another browser completes no login (D-057).
Portal sessionThe server-side session after a Feide login: a Redis record behind the opaque __Host-hvli_sid cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax), ended by logout, after 2 hours without a request or 12 hours after login. It holds the user ID, roles, learnerKey, CSRF token and the encrypted Feide ID token, never a name or Feide ID (AUTH-003, D-057).
CSRF token (synchronizer)One random token per portal session that requests must send back, in the X-CSRF-Token header, a csrf query value (H5P URLs) or a csrf form field. Required for every unsafe method and for any request to /h5p/ajax and /h5p/contentUserData; page scripts read it from GET /auth/session. A missing or wrong token gives 401 hvl:csrf-invalid (D-057).
PrincipalWho a request acts for, in the same shape for both entry points: user ID, learnerKey, roles, mode (portal or lti), locale and, for LTI, the launch facts (apps/server/src/auth/Principal.ts). Built from the portal session or the ltik; it never holds a name, e-mail, Feide ID, LTI sub or token (spec 02 §2, D-053).
Signed file grantThe part of a content-file URL /h5p/files/<grant>/<contentId>/<file> that authorises it: a key ID, an expiry and an HMAC over contentId|expiry made with URL_SIGNING_KEYS. A player render issues it after the View check, for the files origin; the editor page issues one of its own purpose (editor-file-url) after the Edit check, for /h5p/editor-files/<grant>/… on the app origin (D-069, D-110's amendment). It lasts 12 to 13 hours and names no person, so <img> and <video> tags work in a cookie-less iframe (D-058). An editor's fresh uploads load through an upload grant of the same form, /h5p/uploads/<grant>/<accountId>/<file>, an HMAC over accountId|expiry under its own HKDF purpose (temporary-file-url), so no kind of grant opens another (D-069).
Files originThe separate origin the player's user files are served from (SEC-004): files.<host> of PUBLIC_BASE_URL, or FILES_BASE_URL. It answers only signed file requests, with CSP: sandbox and nosniff, reads and sets no cookie, and allows the app origin by CORS without credentials; the app origin answers the same paths with 404 (D-045, D-110's amendment).
ClamAV / clamdThe open-source virus scanner and its daemon, which HVL runs. When CLAMAV_HOST is set, every uploaded file is streamed to clamd before it is stored, and refused unless clamd answers "clean" (SEC-006, fail closed). The EICAR test file is a harmless text every scanner reports, used to check that refusals work (ops/clamav.md ↗ (opens external site)).
Key ringAn environment value id=base64,id=base64,… whose first key is current; older keys still verify or decrypt, so keys rotate without downtime when the new key is first added in second place and moved first only once every server holds it (the three steps are in D-056; D-055 and D-058 apply them to the other two rings). HKDF derives one key per purpose from each key. IDENTITY_HASH_KEYS: identity and audit-IP hashes (D-055). DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEYS: AES-256-GCM for LTI private keys, LTI access tokens and the session's Feide ID token (D-056). URL_SIGNING_KEYS: signed file grants (D-058) and editor upload grants, each under its own HKDF purpose (D-069). PSEUDONYM_SECRETS is keyed by academic year instead (DATA-002).
Design tokenA named brand value (colour, spacing, type) in packages/design-tokens/tokens.json. Code uses only the generated CSS variables (--hvl-…) and Tailwind classes; colour literals elsewhere fail Stylelint and ESLint (UD-001, D-072).
Daylight themeH5P Core 1.28's theme, configured through --h5p-theme-* CSS variables. packages/design-tokens maps HVL tokens onto them (h5p-daylight.css), and hvl-h5p-theme.css adds typography, focus, targets and feedback prefixes on top (UD-011).
FindingOne result of the pre-publish check: rule ID, severity (error, warning, hint), the path of the field in content.json and a message in the author's language. Only errors block publishing (UD-020, UD-021, PED-020).
Chrome pageA Next.js page of apps/web (header, tabs, notices, footer) that frames an H5P player or editor page served by Express on the same origin (D-067).
Nonce (CSP)A random value made for each response and named in its script-src; only scripts carrying it run. Next.js pages use one; H5P pages use 'self' and a hash instead, because H5P writes <script> tags a nonce cannot reach (D-070).
WCAG 2.2 AAWeb Content Accessibility Guidelines, version 2.2, conformance level AA.
Conformance reportdocs/accessibility/WCAG-CONFORMANCE-REPORT.md (UD-040): one section per WCAG 2.2 A/AA criterion with the automated evidence (axe rules, our checks, the last full run) generated by npm run a11y:report, and HVL's manual verdicts kept between manual:start and manual:end markers. It is the source for the tilgjengelegheitserklæring on uustatus.no (D-079's amendments).
DPIAData Protection Impact Assessment (GDPR Art. 35).
SBOMSoftware bill of materials: a machine-readable list of the components a system is built from, with versions, pins and licences, for scanners and advisories. Ours is assurance/sbom.cdx.json ↗ (opens external site) in CycloneDX 1.5, written by npm run sbom (tools/sbom/): the npm packages of a production install, H5P core, the editor and the ten content types by commit, and the container images by digest; its README lists what it leaves out (D-116).
Pseudonym / HMACA keyed hash that replaces a real identifier. It cannot be reversed without the secret key.
k-suppressionHiding any statistic based on fewer than k people.
Test student (Student View)The learner Canvas makes when a teacher chooses Student View; its launch has the LTI TestUser role. HVL Interaktiv treats it as a learner flagged testUser: its plays are stored and graded, so a teacher can test passback, but never counted in insight, the mappe or any k (D-102's amendment).
Yearly purgeThe deletion, from 31 August (PURGE_RUN_DATE), of the learner rows of the academic year that ended on 31 July, chosen by each row's stored academicYear, after the year's k-suppressed snapshots are written; a dry run counts first. Destroying that year's pseudonym secret is a step for HVL operations (DATA-003, D-107, docs/ops/yearly-purge.md).
Data-subject requestA learner's request, passed on by HVL's data protection officer, for access to or erasure of their data (GDPR Art. 15 and 17). HVL operations run it with the server's CLI, giving the person's Feide ID or Canvas sub on standard input; every run is audited with counts only (DATA-008, D-108, docs/ops/data-subject-requests.md).
Database rolesThe three PostgreSQL users of D-109: hvli_migrator owns the schema and runs migrations, hvli_app reads and writes rows and only appends to the audit tables, hvli_analytics reads the k-suppressed view analytics.insight_snapshot and nothing else (DATA-010, docs/ops/database-roles.md).
Request IDThe X-Request-Id on every response and in the request log's one line per request, which names the route pattern, never the URL, so an operator can match a user's report or the proxy's log to the server's without personal data (NFR-006, D-109's amendment).
Language overlay (H5P-tekstar)HVL's Nynorsk and Bokmål texts for the H5P libraries' own buttons, messages, editor labels and editor strings, kept by ALU in content/h5p-tekstar/ and laid over each library's language/nn.json and nb.json when the editor reads them (LanguageOverlayLibraryStorage, after D-046's nb fallback; H5P-008, H5P-010, D-111). Each entry names the library's English text (en), so a library update that changes it is reported by content:check. An activity keeps the texts it was saved with.
Live-contract seamapps/server/live/: the facts the mock Canvas and mock Feide assume, as checks that run against ALU's test Canvas and real Feide when asked (npm run test:live with the LIVE_* variables), or against the mocks (LIVE_TARGET=mock, in CI). A failing check against Canvas means the mock is wrong (D-101's amendments; handoff/live-contract-seam.md ↗ (opens external site)).
Hand-off indexdocs/handoff/README.md ↗ (opens external site): the entry point for HVL's bachelor students (spring 2027): what is done, what needs HVL, what passes to them with a design note each, and the riskiest modules to review first (D-101).
Upstream draftA report HVL Interaktiv owes a project it builds on (Lumi, H5P, clamscan, ltijs), written in docs/upstream/ ↗ (opens external site) for the owner to file; security reports are held outside the public repository until the vendor has fixed them (D-112).
Sak / etikett (GitHub issue / label)How a pilot tester reports a problem: a GitHub issue opened through one of two Nynorsk forms, Feil (a fault) or Barriere for universell utforming (an accessibility barrier), never with personal data; labels mark its type, severity (alvor 1: kritisk, alvor 2: UU-barriere, alvor 3: kosmetisk) and status, for example treng HVL-test (only HVL can re-test it: its Canvas, Feide, a device or a screen reader). Security problems go privately through SECURITY.md (testing/rapportere-problem.md ↗ (opens external site), D-101's amendments).
JiTTJust-in-Time Teaching: using students' pre-work answers to plan the next class.
